lines.en: I walk the mountains in armor.

lines.zh: 我的护甲在石头上碰响。
lines.en: My armor clinks on the stone.
I climb higher, step by step.

lines.zh: 我甩开手臂，装甲跟着动。
lines.en: I swing my arms, the plates moving.
I round a scree slope.
I walk along the ridge line.
My tread is steady.
I walk toward you.
I slowly square my body.
I pass along the rock face.

lines.zh: 我按着步子把距离收紧。
lines.en: I close the distance one measured step at a time.

lines.zh: 我在恶地边上停了一下。
lines.en: I pause at the badlands' edge.
I stand and my armor creaks.
I am watching the distance.
My tail sways slowly behind me.
I flex my gauntlet.

lines.zh: 我在等锚点那边的动静。
lines.en: I wait for movement by my anchor.

lines.zh: 我的护甲在太阳下反光。
lines.en: My armor reflects the sun.
I guard this spot and don't move a step.
I fold my arms.
I listen to the wind.
I shift my weight and my armor clicks.
My breathing stays steady.
I look up at the cliff.
I count the stones here.
I lower my head slightly.
I raise my head and face you.
There is light under my helm.
I am deciding whether you are friend or foe.
You do not look hostile.
I slowly lower my arms.
I nod once at you.
My armor holds still.
You stay silent, so do I.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让出半个身位。
lines.en: I shift aside half a body's width.
I rest a hand at my side.

lines.zh: 我尾尖在身后点了一下。
lines.en: My tail tip taps once behind me.
I am gauging your strength.
I take half a step toward you.
I lift my helm a little.
There is not a trace of hostility in me.
I plant myself and watch you.
A small dent is knocked into my armor.
I step back and steady.
A grunt comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 我按住护甲裂开的那处。
lines.en: I press the split in my armor.
My helm tips; I right it.
I slowly settle my weight lower.
I do not make a sound.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼里的光更亮。
lines.en: I stare, my eyes brighter.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一紧，又慢慢放平。
lines.en: My tail jerks, then slowly levels out.
I roll my shoulder.
I glance and do not reach.
I do not eat such things.
I return it to your hand.
I shake my head gently.

lines.zh: 我捏着它翻过来看背面。
lines.en: I hold it up and turn it over.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿我拿了也没处用。
lines.en: Even if I took this, I'd have no use for it.
I take it, as thanks.
I hand it back.
I look two seconds and turn away.
Put it away. I don't need this.
I hang it at my hip.
I glance once and turn away.
You hit me and my armor rings.
I don't budge; you back off first.

lines.zh: 我抬起护臂把你的力卸开。
lines.en: I raise my arm guard and turn your force aside.
We clang.

lines.zh: 我被顶退半步，马上站定。
lines.en: Knocked back half a step, I plant myself.
My pauldron shoves you aside.
I shift my foot back into place.

lines.zh: 地上被我们踩出两个坑。
lines.en: We leave two dents in the ground.
My armored tail grazes your leg.
I cast a glance down.

lines.zh: 两个装甲身影并排站着。
lines.en: Two armored figures stand side by side.
Our arm guards touch.
It nods to me.
We look to the same spot together.
Our tails nearly touch.

lines.zh: 我们一起在锚点边上守着。
lines.en: We stand watch by the anchor together.
Its hand rests on my shoulder.
Not a word passes between us.
We head up the mountain together.

lines.zh: 我们的护甲在光里一起发亮。
lines.en: Our armor glints together.
I lift it one-handed.
I look and stow it in my armor.

lines.zh: 我把它搁在平整的岩石上。
lines.en: I set it on a flat rock.
I toss it once; it's lighter than I thought.
I hold it up to the light.

lines.zh: 我把它放到你摊开的手上。
lines.en: I place it in your open hand.
I tuck it under my arm.
I set it by my anchor.
I lift it between two fingers.
I set it down slowly.
I raise my head and my armor creaks.
I have recognized hostility.
I step into the middle of the path.

lines.zh: 我把腰沉下来准备发力。
lines.en: I sink my hips, ready to strike.
I begin gathering power.
My gauntlet opens and closes.
I've picked the angle to come in from.
My tail whips straight; my feet fix in place.
I raise my helm.
I take one step forward.
I wait no longer.
My bearing changes.
I follow you block by block.
Wherever you run, I am behind.
I keep this gap the whole time.
The moment your hand lifts, I move.
My armor leaves me unafraid.
I come around the stone.
You retreat, and I advance.
Your footsteps land on the mountain path.
I lower my head and drop my gaze.
My hand stays raised.
I am just two blocks short.
I have not sped up.
My fist hammers your chest.
I ram you with my pauldron.
I sweep your guard aside.
I kick your side.
My tail cracks against you.

lines.zh: 一拳打完，我立刻回到原位。
lines.en: The punch lands; I step right back.
You block and your hands go numb.
I cut in at an angle on your flank.

lines.zh: 我的护手抓住你的手腕。
lines.en: My gauntlet clamps your wrist.
You are driven back three blocks.

lines.zh: 我的拳上起了一点火光。
lines.en: A spark of flame gathers on my fist.
I push a palm into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 山地上多了一个装甲身影。
lines.en: An armored figure appears on the mountainside.
I step out from behind the rock.
You hear metallic footsteps.
I begin patrolling the mountains.

lines.zh: 我的护甲先反了一下光。
lines.en: My armor catches the light first.
I drop from above and land steady.
There is movement by the anchor.
My shadow stretches on the cliff.
I stand on this mountain path.
I begin walking this way.

lines.zh: 风把我的护甲吹得发凉。
lines.en: The wind cools my armor.
I turn my helm your way.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我只是退了退。
lines.en: Fire does nothing to me; I merely step back.

lines.zh: 我从坡上跌下，单膝跪地。
lines.en: I drop from the slope onto one knee.
Water fills my armor's seams, heavy.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得滑了半格。
lines.en: The blast slides me half a block.
An arrow bounces off, leaving a white mark.

lines.zh: 那股力量压住了我的气息。
lines.en: That force smothers my power.
Hunger makes even my armor feel heavy.
Lightning runs around my armor.

lines.zh: 下面空了，我整块坠下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I fall whole.
